story_type: offshore hoist filmed from a Coast Guard jet circling overhead
hook: A jet circled overhead and filmed this rescue 57 miles out.
narration: Fifty-seven miles off Port Aransas, Texas, a Coast Guard jet circling overhead filmed this helicopter rescue.
A crew member on the fishing boat Cap'n Willy had a severe headache, and the captain called for help.
Air Station Corpus Christi launched a Dolphin helicopter and a Falcon jet, and a forty-five foot response boat set out too.
The Falcon flies high above the scene, watching with its camera and keeping radio contact, while the helicopter does the hoist.
The Dolphin moved in low over the boat to bring him up on the hoist.
Its pilot said a bad situation can quickly turn terrible when you are that far from medical treatment.
outcome: The Dolphin crew flew him to an ambulance waiting at Air Station Corpus Christi, and he was taken on to a hospital.
title: Jet filmed this rescue 57 miles out
description:
In May 2014, a Coast Guard Falcon jet filmed a Dolphin helicopter crew hoisting a sick crew member off the fishing boat Cap'n Willy, 57 miles offshore of Port Aransas, Texas.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by USCG Falcon 2105, Sector/Air Station Corpus Christi, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/340150/coast-guard-medevacs-26-year-old-fishing-vessel

question_comment: Have you ever needed help far from shore?

facts.claim: Captain of the Cap'n Willy, 57 miles offshore of Port Aransas, reported a crew member with a severe headache
facts.source_quote: watchstanders at Sector Corpus Christi received a distress report from the captain of the fishing boat Cap’n Willy, located 57 miles offshore of Port Aransas, stating that one of their crew members was suffering from a severe headache.

facts.claim: A Dolphin, a Falcon jet and a 45-foot response boat were launched
facts.source_quote: The Coast Guard launched an aircrew aboard an MH-65 Dolphin helicopter and an aircrew aboard an HU-25 Falcon fan-jet from Air Station Corpus Christi as well a boat crew aboard a 45-foot Response Boat-Medium from Station Port Aransas

facts.claim: Hoisted and taken to an ambulance at Air Station Corpus Christi, then to hospital
facts.source_quote: The helicopter aircrew hoisted the 26-year-old man from the fishing vessel and transported him to an awaiting ambulance at Air Station Corpus Christi. EMS then transported him to Bay Area Hospital.
A bad situation can quickly turn into a terrible one when you’re that far offshore and away from medical treatment.
